summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was executed and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext classes, _make_reader_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file overloads, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods); tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests inserted before the __main__ block); docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759). Not verified: tests, mypy, and black have not been run, so the first real check is running the test suite and mypy. Judgment calls: no suppression added on the module-level open return because the context wrapper is typed Any and strict mypy would flag an unused ignore; wrap_file return also unsuppressed; Progress.open implementation takes mode as str while public overloads expose only 'r', 'rt', 'rb'; docstring lines exceed 88 characters, matching the existing track() style.
